blocks.value: Candles quickly show whether buyers or sellers were stronger during a trading period.
Imagine This: Imagine a tug of war between two teams. One team represents buyers and the other represents sellers. At the end of the game, the winning team determines the direction of the candle.

A Bullish candle usually appears green and means the closing price was higher than the opening price. A Bearish candle usually appears red and means the closing price was lower than the opening price.
Open ₹500, Close ₹520 → Bullish Candle. Open ₹520, Close ₹500 → Bearish Candle.
The candle's color tells who won the battle between buyers and sellers.

blocks.question: A Bullish candle usually means...
choices: The price closed above the opening price.
